domain: Ley de Propiedad Horizontal and tourist letting in a community of owners

rules.statement: A three-fifths majority of owners who also represent three-fifths of participation quotas is required to APPROVE, limit, condition or prohibit tourist letting in the building.
rules.notes: THE WORD 'APPROVE' IS THE CHANGE. Before Ley Organica 1/2025 the three-fifths rule covered only limiting, conditioning or prohibiting, so 3/5 was the threshold to ban. Now the same majority is needed to permit a new tourist let at all. Most guidance still describes the old position. It is a majority of owners AND of quotas, not one or the other.

rules.statement: The current wording takes effect from 3 April 2025.
rules.notes: Later amendments to art. 17 (RDL 7/2025 of 24 June and RDL 7/2026 of 20 March) touch art. 17.1 only, not 17.12.

rules.statement: The agreements have no retroactive effect. An owner already carrying on the activity before the change may continue, but only where the tourist licence or declaracion responsable was obtained before 3 April 2025.

source.name: BOE consolidated text
source.ref: Resolucion DGSJFP of 8 October 2025, published 22 January 2026

rules.notes: A prior municipal urbanistic compatibility report alone is not enough. Two further resolutions on the same point: BOE-A-2026-6851 and BOE-A-2026-14949.

rules.statement: The same three-fifths majority may set a special expense quota or increased share of common expenses for the dwelling carrying on the activity, capped at a 20 percent increase.
Article 17.12 is tied to the activity in art. 5.e LAU, that is tourist letting under regional tourism rules. A genuine seasonal let under art. 3 LAU falls outside it.

source.name: BOE consolidated text
source.ref: art. 17.12 Ley 49/1960 read with arts. 3 and 5.e Ley 29/1994

rules.notes: A community can still restrict uses by other routes such as statutory clauses. The boundary is heavily litigated. Ley Organica 1/2025 also added a new disposicion adicional 2 to the LPH whose text was not read; do not build on it.
